**Claims check**

| Claim | Status |
|---|---|
| "Subscribers can pause or cancel any time" | Allowlisted |
| "free UK delivery on orders over £25" | Allowlisted |
| "means most boxes ship free" | **Unsupported** |
| "Tea that's easy to stop and start" | Soft framing of the pause/cancel claim, fine |

**Problem:** "most boxes ship free" is a quantity claim with no backing. The allowlist says delivery is free over £25. It says nothing about how many orders reach that threshold, and subscription orders could easily fall below it. The draft turns a conditional offer into an implied majority. We also sell tins and tea bags, so "boxes" isn't a product term we've established.

**Compliant version:**

> Tea that's easy to stop and start. Subscribers can pause or cancel any time, and delivery is free in the UK on orders over £25.

**Slop and structure check:** no ban-list words, no em-dashes, no exclamation marks, no rhetorical opener. The opening line is a bit soft, but it states the benefit and leads into the concrete facts.
